meta.title: D4-D6 neural I/O map of the digital Drosophila brain
meta.model: Shiu et al. leaky-integrate-and-fire whole-brain model (MIT, pinned commit 91bdd1e)
meta.annotations: FlyWire/Codex public annotation tables for v783 (classification, consolidated_cell_types, neurons, labels, column_assignment); see brain/data/flywire_annotations_v783/
meta.disclaimer: This map never claims biological equivalence; it documents which v783 populations we will stimulate/read and the evidence behind each choice.

sensory_populations.name: Lamina monopolar cell L1 (ON channel)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Sustained ON / brightness channel; main input from R1-R6 photoreceptors; feeds the ON motion pathway (L1 -> Mi1 -> T4).
provenance: [LIT] Fischbach & Dittrich 1989, Borst 2018, Yang et al. 2016 (Cell)

sensory_populations.name: Lamina monopolar cell L2 (OFF channel)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Transient OFF / contrast channel; feeds the OFF motion pathway (L2 -> Tm1/Tm2 -> T5).
provenance: [LIT] Fischbach & Dittrich 1989, Borst 2018, Fu et al. 2020

sensory_populations.name: Lamina monopolar cell L3 (sustained brightness)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Sustained luminance / contrast channel operating in darkness; modulates both ON and OFF pathways.

sensory_populations.name: Transmedullary OFF-pathway cells (Tm1,Tm2,Tm3,Tm4,Tm9)
sensory_populations.biological_function: OFF-edge relay from lamina to lobula; Tm1/Tm2/Tm4/Tm9 provide the delayed and direct lines of the OFF motion detector.
provenance: [LIT] Shinomiya et al. 2014, Takemura et al. 2017, Fu et al. 2020

sensory_populations.name: Medulla intrinsic ON-pathway cells (Mi1,Mi4,Mi9,T2,T3)
sensory_populations.biological_function: ON-edge relay: Mi1 (direct) and Mi4/Mi9 (delayed) converge onto T4 dendrites.

sensory_populations.name: T4a-d (ON direction-selective columnar neurons)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Direction-selective ON motion detectors; four subtypes (a,b,c,d) tile four directional preferences; principal input to lobula-plate tangential cells.
sensory_populations.proposed_mapping: motion direction (ON edges), optic flow components

sensory_populations.name: T5a-d (OFF direction-selective columnar neurons)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Direction-selective OFF motion detectors; four subtypes (a,b,c,d); converge with T4 onto the same tangential cells.
sensory_populations.proposed_mapping: motion direction (OFF edges), optic flow components

sensory_populations.name: Horizontal-system tangential cells (HSN,HSE,HSS)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Wide-field neurons integrating horizontal retinal large-field motion (optic flow); HSN/HSE/HSS are electrophysiologically characterized motion-vision neurons.

sensory_populations.name: Vertical-system tangential cells (VS1-VS8)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Wide-field neurons integrating vertical retinal large-field motion (optic flow), each covering a distinct part of the visual field.

sensory_populations.name: Lobula plate / lobula columnar type 2 (LPLC2)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Looming (expanding-edge) detector; encodes angular size/velocity of approaching objects; provides the dominant optic-lobe input to the giant fiber (DNp01) escape pathway.
provenance: [LIT] von Reyn et al. 2017, Ache et al. 2019 (Curr Biol), Lopez et al. 2024

sensory_populations.name: LPLC1 and LPLC4 (looming-family columnar neurons)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Looming-responsive columnar projection neurons of the lobula plate/lobula cluster; response properties distinct from LPLC2.
provenance: [LIT] Wu et al. 2016 (eLife), Klapoetke et al. 2022

sensory_populations.name: Lobula columnar LC4
sensory_populations.biological_function: Visual projection neuron contributing with LPLC2 most of the optic-lobe input to the giant fiber; required for normal timing of looming escape.
provenance: [LIT] von Reyn et al. 2017, Williamson et al. 2018, Lopez et al. 2024

sensory_populations.name: Lobula columnar LC16
sensory_populations.biological_function: Small-object / approaching-object detector; optogenetic activation induces backward walking hypothesised to be mediated by moonwalker descending neurons.
provenance: [LIT] Sen et al. 2017 (Cell Rep), Wu et al. 2016

sensory_populations.name: Lobula columnar LC17
sensory_populations.biological_function: Edge-motion sensitive visual projection neuron implicated in visual approach/looming-adjacent behaviours.
provenance: [LIT] Wu et al. 2016, Klapoetke et al. 2022, preprint evidence 2026

sensory_populations.name: Lobula columnar LC9
sensory_populations.biological_function: Visual projection neuron providing a major input to P9/DNp09 (forward-walking/turning command); part of the object-directed walking pathway.
provenance: [LIT] Wu et al. 2016, Bidaye et al. 2020 (Neuron)

sensory_populations.name: Medulla-to-tubercle neurons (MeTu)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Anterior visual pathway carrying (non-topographic and topographic) visual information via the bulb to the central complex (navigation/pol-ish-light cues); not a primary entry for game vision.
provenance: [LIT] Omoto et al. 2017, Timaeus et al. 2020

sensory_populations.name: Labellar sugar-sensing gustatory receptor neurons (tutorial set)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Sugar-taste sensory neurons; the tutorial stimulus set of the Shiu et al. model; establishes the precedent of sensory entry into the digital brain.
sensory_populations.proposed_mapping: (legacy tutorial input; precedent for sensory entry)

sensory_populations.name: Olfactory receptor neuron axons (class: olfactory)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Chemosensory entry into the antennal lobe; not used by the game (no olfactory display), registered for completeness.

sensory_populations.name: Mechanosensory neurons (incl. Johnston's organ)
sensory_populations.biological_function: Mechanical vibration / sound entry (Johnston's organ); future optional entry point if game audio is ever mapped.
provenance: [LIT] FlyWire v783 annotations, Kamikouchi et al. 2009

learning_reward_populations.name: Kenyon cells (all compartments)
learning_reward_populations.biological_function: Sparse coders of the mushroom body (~2,500 per hemisphere; v783 lists 5,177 total); receive converging sensory-projection input in the calyx; sites of dopaminergic plasticity onto MBONs.
references: Li et al. 2020 (eLife hemibrain MB map)
provenance: [LIT] Aso et al. 2014 (eLife), Li et al. 2020 (eLife hemibrain MB map)

learning_reward_populations.name: Mushroom-body output neurons (MBON01-35)
learning_reward_populations.region: Mushroom body lobes -> LH, SIP, SMP, crepine
learning_reward_populations.biological_function: Convergent readout of KC activity; compartment-organised; activation of single MBON types is sufficient to drive approach or avoidance behaviour (valence-carrying output).

learning_reward_populations.name: PAM-cluster dopaminergic neurons (PAM01-15)
learning_reward_populations.biological_function: Reward/appetitive reinforcement: PAM neurons convey sugar and water reward to MB compartments; reward-memory formation requires PAM activity.
provenance: [LIT] Liu et al. 2012, Aso et al. 2012, Huetteroth et al. 2015, Yamagata et al. 2016, McCurdy et al. 2021
learning_reward_populations.proposed_mapping: REWARD events (game gains: EXP, level-up, item, quest)

learning_reward_populations.name: PPL1-cluster dopaminergic neurons (PPL1-01..08)
learning_reward_populations.biological_function: Punishment/aversive reinforcement: PPL1 neurons convey electric shock and bitter punishment; induce aversive memory; some types signal absolute vs relative punishment.
provenance: [LIT] Aso et al. 2010, Aso et al. 2012, McCloy et al. 2022 (biorxiv)

learning_reward_populations.name: PPL2-cluster dopaminergic neurons (PPL2-01..04)
learning_reward_populations.biological_function: Dopaminergic cluster with less completely characterised behavioural roles; registered, not used initially.
provenance: [LIT] FlyWire v783 annotations, Kong et al. 2017

learning_reward_populations.name: Anterior paired lateral (APL) neuron
learning_reward_populations.biological_function: Giant GABAergic feedback neuron providing normalisation / gain control and negativ feedback onto KCs; anti-Hebbian opponent in some plasticity models.
provenance: [LIT] Inada et al. 2017, Papadopoulou et al. 2013, Masquez et al. 2018

learning_reward_populations.name: Dorsal paired medial (DPM) neuron
learning_reward_populations.biological_function: Neuromodulatory feedback neuron required for memory consolidation; releases 5-HT and peptides across MB lobes.
provenance: [LIT] Yu et al. 2005, Yu et al. 2015, Scheffer et al. 2020

learning_reward_populations.name: Dopaminergic DESCENDING neurons (DopaMeander candidates)
learning_reward_populations.biological_function: Dopaminergic modulatory descending neurons; Liessem et al. (2026) show the DopaMeander DAN-DNs drive forward walking with increased ipsiversive turning. v783 contains 7 dopaminergic DNs; the exact DopaMeander correspondence is not yet published in ID-resolved form.

descending_motor_populations.name: All descending neurons (brain -> nerve cord)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: The complete descending interface between brain and ventral nerve cord; 1,305 neurons of 473 types in v783 (all exit nerve CV).

descending_motor_populations.name: Moonwalker descending neurons (MDN)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: Bilateral command neurons for backward walking: optogenetic activation drives backward walking, silencing impairs it; also engaged by visual looming/escape.
provenance: [LIT] Bidaye et al. 2014 (Science), Sen et al. 2017 (Cell Rep)

descending_motor_populations.name: P9 / DNp09 descending neurons
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: Command neurons for forward walking with ipsilateral turning; receive major input from LC9 visual projection neurons and courtship circuitry; required for male pursuit.
provenance: [LIT] Bidaye et al. 2020 (Neuron), Sapkal et al. 2024 (Nature)
descending_motor_populations.proposed_mapping: FORWARD + ipsiversive TURN (left neuron -> turn left)

descending_motor_populations.name: Bolt protocerebral neurons (BPN, types 1-4, central command)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: Central-brain command neurons for straight, fast forward walking; BPN activation initiates/maintains straight walking; not required for courtship; feed major SEZ descending neurons.
provenance: [LIT] Bidaye et al. 2020 (Neuron), author labels in FlyWire

descending_motor_populations.name: Roadrunner neurons (RRN, CB0257 pair)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: Bilateral pair of central brain neurons whose activation initiates forward walking and modulates walking speed; characterized as the dedicated forward-walking circuit together with their downstream leg DN cluster.

descending_motor_populations.name: Leg descending-neuron cluster (Dallmann 2026 DN_leg_cluster)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: The descending leg-control cluster (11 types) characterised downstream of the forward-walking command; carries the forward program to the legs.

descending_motor_populations.name: Giant fibers (DNp01)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: Command neuron pair of the escape jump / flight-startle pathway; driven by LPLC2+LC4 looming input; the fastest conductance route to jump motor programs.
provenance: [LIT] King & Wyman 1980, von Reyn et al. 2017, Ache et al. 2019
descending_motor_populations.proposed_mapping: STARTLE/JUMP (mapped to game jump/dash or emergency escape)

descending_motor_populations.name: Foxglove (FG) halt neurons (CB0890)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: GABAergic walk-OFF neuron pair that selectively inhibits forward-walking descending commands; activation halts forward walking (halting during feeding).
provenance: [LIT] Sapkal et al. 2024 (Nature), Sterne et al. 2021

descending_motor_populations.name: Bluebell (BB) halt neurons (DNg60)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: GABAergic walk-OFF neuron pair that selectively inhibits turning-related walking commands; activation halts turning.
provenance: [LIT] Sapkal et al. 2024 (Nature), Sterne et al. 2021

descending_motor_populations.name: Brake neurons (BRK1-6, ascending)
descending_motor_populations.region: VNC leg neuromeres -> brain SEZ (ascending axons)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: Cholinergic ascending brake neurons; activation arrests stepping and stabilises joints; mutually exclusive with walk-OFF use; engage during grooming. Present in v783 via their ascending axons (AN_GNG_53/54/76).
descending_motor_populations.proposed_mapping: STOP (active brake; VNC part not in brain-only connectome)

descending_motor_populations.name: Brain motor neurons (incl. MN9/CB0701)
descending_motor_populations.biological_function: Final common-path motor neurons of the brain (proboscis, pharynx, head); MN9 (CB0701) is the tutorial readout used in Gate-1 evidence.

proposed_input_channels.description: Visual target present in LEFT visual hemifield (coarse)
proposed_input_channels.encoding: Poisson drive at rate proportional to target salience onto LEFT-eye members of the entry populations (hemisphere = hemifield at this stage)
proposed_input_channels.notes: Refinement path: use column_assignment x/y to stimulate only columns covering the target's screen position.

proposed_input_channels.description: Visual target present in RIGHT visual hemifield (coarse)
proposed_input_channels.encoding: same as vis_target_left but RIGHT-eye members
Poisson drive whose rate scales with simulated angular expansion velocity
differential drive of HS vs VS populations signed by flow direction

proposed_input_channels.description: Directional motion in the visual field (object movement)
proposed_input_channels.encoding: subtype-selective drive: T4a-d/T5a-d subtypes correspond to four directional preferences; drive the subtype matching the CV-measured motion vector
proposed_input_channels.notes: Direction->subtype assignment needs a calibration experiment before use.

proposed_input_channels.encoding: L1 (ON) vs L2 (OFF) drive ratio encodes luminance change; L3 baseline encodes ambient level

proposed_input_channels.description: Discrete approaching object (non-looming, e.g. NPC walking toward player)
proposed_input_channels.encoding: LC16/LC17 drive scaled by object size/approach speed; fallback to LPLC2 for fast expansions

proposed_input_channels.description: Game reward event (EXP gain, level-up, item, quest complete)
proposed_input_channels.encoding: brief Poisson burst onto a PAM reward subset (biological analog: sugar-reward DAN activation)
proposed_input_channels.notes: ENGINEERED: game events are not sugar; the mapping is an analogy that must stay labeled.

proposed_input_channels.description: Game punishment event (damage taken, death, fall)
proposed_input_channels.encoding: brief Poisson burst onto a PPL1 punishment subset (biological analog: shock/bitter DAN activation)

proposed_output_actions.decoder_rule: FORWARD if (rate(BPN_type1)+rate(RRN)+rate(DNp09)) / n > theta_fwd for T samples; theta_fwd from baseline distribution
proposed_output_actions.known_behavior: BPN: straight fast forward; RRN: initiates forward + speed; DNp09: forward + ipsilateral turning

proposed_output_actions.decoder_rule: BACKWARD if rate(MDN) > theta_bwd (per side; bilateral activation = straight backward)
proposed_output_actions.known_behavior: MDN activation drives backward walking (Bidaye 2014); necessary for it

proposed_output_actions.status: biologically separable (as turning, not as pure translation)
proposed_output_actions.decoder_rule: TURN-LEFT if rate(DNp09_left) > rate(DNp09_right) + delta (ipsilateral turning: left DNp09 turns left)
proposed_output_actions.known_behavior: DNp09 drives forward walking with ipsilateral turning

proposed_output_actions.status: biologically separable (as turning, not as pure translation)
biologically separable (two mechanisms; we use walk-OFF)
proposed_output_actions.decoder_rule: STOP if (rate(FG)+rate(BB))/n > theta_stop OR all walk populations below theta_idle for T_idle samples; STOP is also the DEFAULT (failsafe) state
proposed_output_actions.known_behavior: FG halts forward walking, BB halts turning (walk-OFF); BRK actively brakes (partly VNC-resident)

proposed_output_actions.status: biologically separable (bonus action, maps to game jump/dash if present)
proposed_output_actions.decoder_rule: JUMP if rate(DNp01) > theta_jump (requires strong looming input)
